events.name: The Cash Box Kings
events.info: , "rdquo" -> One of the best blues bands in the land. Any of these musicians could have played with the great bands of the golden blues era. Together they keep a sound alive that many thought was no more." --- Living Blues , "rdquo" -> Unflinching blues distilled to its essence and steeped in tradition." --- Chicago Tribune , "rdquo" -> An enthusiastic celebration of Chicago blues in all of its electric forms. The Cash Box Kings don't merely pay homage to the past, they bring tradition into the present, making the case that the blues can still speak forcefully and directly about contemporary life." --- AllMusic For more than 25 years, The Cash Box Kings have been carrying the raw, rollicking spirit of classic Chicago blues into the present. Now, with a powerful new voice at the helm, the band is entering an exciting new chapter. Founded by Chicago Blues Hall of Fame inductee and harmonica powerhouse Joe Nosek, The Cash Box Kings have built an international reputation for their fiercely authentic take on the music they love. Their sound draws deeply from the electrifying blues of the 1950s and '60s, while embracing jumping proto-rock 'n' roll, early New Orleans-style R&B, Retro Soul, and the band's own hard-charging hybrid of Chicago blues and Memphis rockabilly---what the Kings affectionately call , "rdquo" -> bluesabilly." As MOJO put it, the band are , "rdquo" -> experts in classic Chicago grooves," evoking Muddy Waters and Little Walter while also delivering original songs that are , "rdquo" -> both funny and pointed." AllMusic praised their , "rdquo" -> enthusiastic celebration of Chicago blues in all of its electric forms," noting the band's combination of witty, sharp songwriting and an ability to bring tradition into the present: , "rdquo" -> The Cash Box Kings make the case that the blues can still speak forcefully and directly about contemporary life." Featuring Nosek and Webb alongside keyboardist Lee Kanehira, bassist John W. Lauler, guitarists Billy Flynn and Andrew Diehl, and drummers Derek Hendrickson and Kenny , "rdquo" -> Beedy Eyes" Smith, the album showcases everything that has made The Cash Box Kings a singular force in contemporary blues: deep Chicago grooves, explosive harmonica, powerful vocals, sharp songwriting, jumping rhythms, and the unmistakable chemistry of a great live band. That combination of reverence and originality has been at the heart of The Cash Box Kings since Nosek founded the group in Madison, Wisconsin, in 2001. As a teenager growing up in the Chicago suburbs, Nosek began sneaking into Chicago blues clubs to see legends including Junior Wells, James Cotton, Otis Rush, Jimmy Rogers, and Sunnyland Slim. Those experiences inspired him to take up harmonica and develop the driving, expressive style that has become one of the band's defining sounds. After moving to Madison to attend college, he began sitting in with artists including Clyde Stubblefield and Luther Allison before assembling a group of like-minded musicians determined to play raw, rough-edged, hard-charging blues. more..

events.name: In Her Own Words x Every Avenue
events.info: Perfectly Unfamiliar TourFor the last decade, In Her Own Words have quietly become one of the most beloved and consistent voices in modern pop punk, building a dedicated fanbase through brutally honest songwriting, massive singalong choruses, and the kind of emotional connection that only comes from lived experience.In 2026, the band celebrates the 10 year anniversary of their breakthrough album Unfamiliar, the record that helped define a generation of emotionally charged pop-punk and introduced fans to songs that still hit just as hard today. From bedroom speakers to packed clubs around the world, Unfamiliar became more than just an album. It became a soundtrack for growing up, falling apart, and figuring yourself out along the way.To celebrate the milestone, the band will be performing Unfamiliar in full on a special anniversary co-headline tour alongside longtime scene favorites Every Avenue. Bringing together two bands whose songs helped shape the soundtrack of the late 2000s and 2010s emo and pop punk scene, the tour is designed as both a nostalgic celebration and a reminder of why these songs continue to resonate with fans years later. more...Every Avenue is an American pop-punk band from Marysville, Michigan, formed in 2003. Before their temporary disbandment, the group consisted of David Ryan Strauchman (lead vocals, piano), Joshua Randall Withenshaw (lead guitar), Jimmie Deeghan (rhythm guitar, backing vocals), Matt Black (bass, backing vocals) and Dennis Wilson (drums, percussion). The band is signed to Fearless Records and released their debut album, Shh, Just Go with it in 2008. It was followed up by their second album, Picture Perfect, in 2009, which reached No. 136 on Billboard 200. In 2011, the bands latest and third album titled Bad Habits was released, and it peaked at No. 63 on Billboard 200, being the bands highest chart position and sold over 300,000 Records Worldwide.. Every Avenue has toured with bands such as Mayday Parade, All Time Low, The Maine on The Compromising of Integrity, Morality and Principles in Exchange for Money Tour, Boys Like Girls, and have appeared on the Vans Warped Tour. In 2023, David Strauchman announced The Light In The Dark Tour with support from rising pop-punk band Makeout, and emo-pioneer SayWeCanFly including co-headline dates with Sparks The Rescue.special guest: Fluorescents
